name: packaging-config
deprecation_criterion: Superseded when the framework adopts a different distribution channel than a self-hosted Claude Code plugin marketplace, or when later slices fold this into a full configure/run UX feature.
spec_no_change_reason: Spec slice-2 already permits a 0.2.x patch bump on each re-ship of the plugin tree; this cycle re-ships run_tick.py + status.py so the installed plugin reports the loaded route source (#59) and bumps 0.2.5->0.2.6, no spec text change.
